name: py-debug-plus
description: Extras for debugging Python: step back (recorded replay), auto-open functions you step into, list range control and a live variables panel.

pyDebugPlus.maxHistory.description: How many stops to record for Step Back.

pyDebugPlus.defaultListRange.description: Items shown per list/tuple/array before you set a range.

pyDebugPlus.maxDepth.description: How many levels of nested values the live panel expands.

pyDebugPlus.maxChildren.description: Max entries read per variable group.

pyDebugPlus.autoOpenLiveView.description: Open the Live Variables panel when a Python debug session starts.

pyDebugPlus.stepIntoLibraries.description: Turn off debugpy's 'justMyCode' for Python sessions so stepping can enter built-in and pip package code. Applies to sessions started after the change.

pyDebugPlus.showLibraryVariables.description: Show imported built-in/pip modules in the Live Variables panel, and variables while paused inside library code. Off by default. Your own modules are shown but never expanded.

pyDebugPlus.keepDefaultDebugViewClosed.description: Keep VS Code's Run and Debug side panel from opening when debugging starts or pauses (sets debug.openDebug to neverOpen).

pyDebugPlus.skipFrozenFrames.description: If a step lands in Python-internal frozen code with no source file (e.g. import machinery), keep stepping in until real code is reached.

pyDebugPlus.stopDebuggingOnClose.description: Stop all debug sessions when VS Code (or the extension host) shuts down, so the debugged program does not keep running.

pyDebugPlus.hideDefaultInlineValues.description: Turn off VS Code's inline values (the grey values it draws next to every variable in the editor) when debugging starts. Sets debug.inlineValues to false.

pyDebugPlus.showInlineSelected.description: Show the values of your chosen variables at the end of the lines that use them while paused.

pyDebugPlus.runLineMaxTries.description: When you run a line while the program is running and name a function or class, how many times to pause and retry until the program is inside it.

pyDebugPlus.liveRefreshMs.description: Live refresh: how often (in milliseconds) the program is briefly paused so your chosen variables can be re-read. Minimum 250.

pyDebugPlus.rerunDelayMs.description: Rerun on save: wait this long after a save before restarting, so several quick saves restart once.

pyDebugPlus.orderByCreation.description: Show an object's attributes (and dictionary entries) in the order they were created instead of alphabetically.
